description: Find a company by name or Swiss UID (CHE-123.456.789); an LEI or ISIN finds the Swiss company that carries it, or a company outside Switzerland that Antevo holds because it owns a Swiss one (a thin file). Returns candidates, each with its `entity_id`, legal form and seat; no file is opened. Pass the chosen candidate's `entity_id` to company_file. `country` is optional. Names find Swiss companies only in this version; a name with another country answers `not_covered`.
name: find_company
title: Find company
